_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P2 operational targets.

requirements.description: Trace one real public rug from its launch through a bridge to a publicly evidenced exchange cluster in a private packet; if a candidate cannot meet the evidence floor, retain it as unmet and do not lower grades or publish an accusation.
requirements.title: Private cross-chain rug showcase

validation.notes: Only close with a privately retained real public-rug trace whose launch, bridge, and exchange-cluster links each meet their evidence floor; record the candidate and unmet reason if the evidence floor fails.

requirements.description: Reconcile Treasury fork-wallet activity from chain data alone, including replay, removal, re-inclusion, and exact quantity; do not read Treasury databases, use signing keys, broadcast, or modify Treasury code.
requirements.title: Treasury fork reconciliation

validation.notes: Run deterministic fork-chain reconciliation tests for exact quantities, removed/replayed/re-included events, and independent JSON-RPC balance reads without Treasury database, key, signing, or broadcast access.

requirements.description: Have the owner-owned CI2 evaluator import and test the same Go library against seeded linkability cases; claim adoption only after the real CI2 consumer path and test pass, and leave the target open if no owner-owned import path exists.
requirements.title: Crypto Infrastructure CI2 adoption

validation.notes: Compile and run the owner-owned Crypto Infrastructure CI2 test importing packages/chain-forensics; leave this requirement open until that real import and seeded linkability test pass.
